description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to a Class Sui Generis (HMO - house in multiple occupation) involving single storey rear infill extension involving replacement of existing conservatory, rear dormer, with associated cycle and refuse storage.

Within 2 months of this permission, details of the required 7 no. long-stay cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. For the avoidance of doubt these details should demonstrate:Location: Near entrances or main access,Design: StandsSecurity: Secure, overlooked, well-lit,Full enclosed: 4 walls and a roof,Accessibility: 1.2m wide, Step-free, no obstructions.The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to conform to Enfield DMD policy 45 and promote sustainable modes of transport.

Within 2 months of this permission, details of refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste shall be provided within the development in pursuance of the HMO hereby approved and in accordance with the Enfield Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). This shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such thereafter.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste  reduction targets.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture the external materials and appearance of the existing dwelling unless otherwise specified in the approved application unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority the development shall thereafter be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 7 people at any one time and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms, and the kitchen/dining room shall be retained as such, in accordance with the approved plans, in perpetuity.  Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Prior to the first use or occupation of the development hereby approved details of the SuDS measures to be incorporated into the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing. The approved SuDS measures shall thereafter be maintained in accordance with the approved details for the lifetime of the development unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Reason: to ensure that the site benefits from adequate drainage arrangements, to ensure the amenity of any future occupants of the site and the amenity of neighbouring properties. To comply with the provisions of Policies DMD59 and DMD61 and the NPPF.

Prior to the first use or occupation of the development hereby approved details of the Secure by Design measures to be included into the development to include details of doors and windows and the security rating of locking mechanisms for the doors windows and cycle storage along with details of any CCTV, Alarm or other monitoring equipment of security lighting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Reason: To ensure the safety and security of any future occupants of the site, to prevent crime and to comply with the provisions of s.17 of the Crime and Disorder Act (1998) as amended.
